subject: Kickoff: HMC posterior reference for uncertainty calibration
body:
Hi all,

Kickoff for the BNN posterior baseline work. Context: our open-source HMC study showed BNNs can beat standard training and deep ensembles, and - usefully for us - that a single long HMC chain represents the posterior about as well as multiple shorter chains. That makes full-batch HMC viable as a gold-standard reference our platform can score cheaper uncertainty methods against.

Product framing: an "uncertainty calibration report" for data-platforms customers, scoring their deep-ensemble or SGMCMC predictive distributions against HMC references on standard benchmarks.

Window is tight (Mar 9 - May 18). M1: repro of the JAX HMC pipeline by Apr 3. M2: reference posterior library for 3 benchmark datasets by May 1. M3: scoring API spec by May 15.

Efe is TL; Maren owns the pipeline engineering. Bruno will cover staffing and compute this week.

Dmitri
